run.network_inputs: RGB plus camera/time IDs; no GT depth, poses, visibility or future tracks
run.alignment: one camera-center Sim(3) per complete sequence, using provided calibration
run.query_adapter: closest predicted source anchor among calibrated in-frame projections
run.query_anchor: constant offset from supplied query XYZ; no future track fitting
run.visibility: native head >0.5 OR across input views
run.resize: full-FOV aspect preserving, bilinear align_corners=True, bottom/right zero padding to patch14
